events.summary: Time, physical reality and distinct world layers begin.
The first enduring stone forms.
Water carves persistent basins.
Self-maintaining life spreads.
Reflective minds emerge.
Early human settlements share durable tools, stories and mobile food networks.
Esh Vel first learns Shared Labor through consensual collaborative Bond practice.
Esh Vel uses the coercive Chain Oath on an unnamed captive; an Echo scar endures.
The Night Archivist emerges as a sapient predatory memory-being in the Veil.
The Night Archivist deliberately steals a witness memory; harm confirms moral agency.
Human communities spread across temperate valleys through migration and multi-village kinship.
The first recorded seasonal beast refuge is established by early herder communities.
Village cultures establish permanent homes.
Cultivation, animal care, storage and river transport expand across human-majority settlements.
A migrating Hornborn community refuses compelled river tribute.
Early human-led river trade compacts finance bridges, seed stores and defended market roads.
The first comparative guild records show humans holding the greatest settled infrastructure in the documented heartlands.
The Low Lantern Shrine is established by travelers tending a communal flame.
The Lantern Hearthkeepers establish a continuing care order.
Crownspire acquires a permanent named city charter predating the Vael Taryn crown.
Vael Taryn crown is established.
Crownspire noble houses establish an inter-house council with political influence.
Wayfarers' Guild forms.
Stonebridge Town establishes a council and public bridge-market.
The crown charters its first central survey office.
The Gloam Chain establishes a clandestine captive-binding market.
Grainmere Village becomes a permanent farming settlement.
Hollowford becomes a chartered village.
Stonebridge builds a shared market hall with managed weights.
Deepkin and resident allies establish the Brackenhold Enclave.
Brackenhold's assembly affirms self-government and trade treaties.
A Reedfen River League agreement establishes navigation and marsh norms.
Reedfen Stiltward expands as a mixed human and Reedfolk settlement.
The Boatfolk Union is constituted to coordinate ferries and rights.
The Crown Granary is built to reduce urban crop shocks.
Bellward March gains its charter.
Bellward Manor is built.
Bellward Ward becomes a chartered service settlement around the manor.
Bellward Wardens form as an official patrol order.
Vael Taryn adopts the Unbound Charter against nonconsensual Chain Oaths.
Dawnridge Borough forms around the east quarry and military road.
Eastwatch Garrison receives permanent civil administration.
The Ashenwood Hunting Circle organizes patrols and wildlife management.
Copperfall Smithy establishes a forge near the mine's mouth.
Grainmere farmers establish a compact to share seed stores.
The Crown Hide Levy increases pressure on forest beasts and frontier residents.
A charter ledger records humans as the leading population and state-building community across the known heartlands.
Varek Sorn unlocks Shared Labor while organizing traders.
Harven practices trail reading.
Patrols seize animal hides under the levy; customary law and welfare conflict.
Thornlock Pens are built behind a trading compound.
The Night Archivist projects harmful memory whispers around the Old Cairn.
Stonehorn Camp forms as a Hornborn refuge in the eastern forest margin.
A sanctuary around Ashenwood breeding sites is formally protected.
Maera unlocks Shared Labor.
Farming, mining, caravan routes, and urban storehouses are joined in a regional distribution charter.
Sela unlocks Water Sense.
Varek Sorn uses the forbidden Chain Oath on captives hidden in Thornlock Pens.
Yorren Pike gains Trail Reading as a paid tracker; the skill is ethically neutral.
The Unbound Watch forms to find captives and document illegal coercion.
Hollowford council formally recognizes temporary shelter rights for nonviolent fugitives.
Tessa unlocks Ember Tending.
Rauka Stonehorn unlocks Material Reading while improving camp defenses.
Mereth Vale learns Resonance Listening while gathering witness accounts.
Mereth unlocks Witness Scar while studying traumatic echoes at the Cairn.
Neris unlocks Trail Reading.
Ilyan unlocks Material Reading.
The Unbound Watch frees captives from the Gloam Chain network.
Rauka finds remnants of binding chains in the subterranean Chain Vault.
A revolt partly destroys Thornlock Market while clandestine trade survives.
Tessa unlocks Forge Heat Shaping.
Ashmaw the wolf takes a sick goat: an ecological conflict, not a moral crime.
Bellward authorities debate recognition of Hornborn autonomy.
Regional demographic estimates are reconciled before the High Banners snapshot.
Reference snapshot; no live simulation tick.

limitations: Historical events are authored, not observed simulation.
Evil, taboos, historical rescue and atrocities are authored history, not output from running NPC decisions.
Veil consciousness ENT-001 has no surface coordinates; manifestation at a site is not physical co-location.
Laws and taboos are culture-dependent records; legal status and moral justification differ.
Human predominance describes the currently known and documented inhabited sphere, not a measured global census of undiscovered continents.
Demographic figures are authored settlement estimates, not a simulated headcount.

species.name: Human
species.classification: Widespread sapient civilization-builder with demographic, agricultural and institutional predominance in the known inhabited world

species.name: Deepkin
species.classification: Sapient underground communities, craft and quarry traditions; not inherently submissive or hostile

species.name: Reedfolk
species.classification: Sapient river and marsh cultures with complex trade and kinship

species.name: Gloam hound
species.classification: Rare altered nonsapient predatory fauna associated with Echo disturbances; not ethically guilty

species.name: Cloud wyvern
species.classification: Rare flying predator; hunting and territorial behavior; wing energy and nesting constraints

species.name: Glassback boar
species.classification: Armored woodland omnivore; aggressive if cornered, ecological seed disperser

species.name: Copperfall basilisk
species.classification: Rare subterranean reptilian predator; localized stone-hardening defense costs heat and energy

species.name: Reed-stalker
species.classification: Wetland amphibian ambush predator; sensitive to drought and food-web disturbance
